name: Suzhou Alton Electrical & Mechanical Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Alton Electrical & Mechanical Industry Co., Ltd. (SAEMIC) specializes in the comprehensive lifecycle of electromechanical products, from initial design and development through production and assembly. These products are distributed and utilized across a global market, with a strong presence in regions like the United States and Canada. A significant part of their offering includes versatile dry and wet vacuum cleaners. These cleaning devices cater to a wide array of environments, ranging from typical household and office use to more demanding garage and industrial settings. Beyond vacuum technology, the company also manufactures automotive cleaning solutions and compact air compressors. To complement their main offerings, SAEMIC supplies various product accessories, such as extension tubes, specialized suction nozzles, flexible hoses, floor brushes, and flat suctions. Established in 2009, the firm's operations are headquartered in Suzhou, China.
